//: The convention treefmt-nix and devshell use, with one addition that matters here.
Nothing in this repository auto-merges: the toolchain is what the score is computed
from, so a flake.lock bump can move a pinned fixture and needs a human to read the
diff. docs/VERSIONING.md makes that explicit -- a release that moves the score must
record the movement and show the shipped threshold still yields the same verdicts.

schedule: before 6am on the first day of the month

packageRules.//: One PR for the flake inputs. Splitting them means the toolchain moves in pieces, which is exactly the non-atomic case flake.nix's determinism comment forbids.
The pinned GitHub Actions in .github/workflows are SHA-pinned with the version in a trailing comment; renovate keeps that pair in step.
